title: Bar Series Blends Watermelon x Energy Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Watermelon & Energy Ice from the Bar Series Blends collection combines the juicy, sweet taste of ripe watermelon with the refreshing sensation of a fruit sports drink on ice. This e-liquid provides a unique and refreshing vape experience, perfect for those who enjoy a blend of light and refreshing flavours. Bar Series Blends Nic Salts capture the intense, concentrated flavours of disposables in a more convenient and versatile alternative to single-use vapes that’s better for your wallet and the environment. Just one 10ml Bar Series bottle offers five times the vaping enjoyment of a traditional 2ml disposable vape bar and can be used in a vast array of vape devices. Bar Series are a collection of nic salt and shortfill e-liquids that capture the intense, concentrated flavours of disposables but in a more convenient and versatile alternative to single-use vapes that’s better for your wallet and the environment. Just one 10ml Bar Series bottle offers five times the vaping as a traditional 2ml disposable vape bar and can be used in a vast array of vape devices. Bar Series Nic Salts are formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, making them ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter vape kits and pod devices. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths in a Nicotine Salt formulation, these e-liquids offer a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine delivery, perfect for adult smokers and vapers looking for fast and effective nicotine relief. Choose from over 40 captivating flavours in the Bar Series collection, from classic dessert to juicy fruits, frosty menthols, bubbly beverages, timeless tobaccos and many more!
